startup_task_shuffle_enable_help: Off by default. When enabled, due tasks are grouped by numeric priority (lower numbers first); the selected scheduling rule supplies the order within each group. Draw once at startup: a 20% chance shuffles eligible equal-priority tasks, otherwise keep their within-group order. Both outcomes honor priority. Restart stays first and running tasks are not preempted. Later occurrences do not shuffle but still respect priority. Refreshes never redraw; disabling restores the selected scheduling rule.
random_delay_interval_help: Enter minimum,maximum non-negative integer seconds, e.g. 2,10 or 5,15. Minimum must not exceed maximum. Equal bounds give a fixed delay; 0,0 skips waiting. Defaults to 2,10 for old configurations; requires the random delay switch.
settlement_burst_enable_help: Independent switch, on by default. Shared settlement actions attempt 2-3 clicks with 15% probability, otherwise one click. Wait 0.1-0.2s plus backend/click delays between inputs; recheck the original settlement marker before each extra input and stop when it disappears. Custom actions are unchanged.
random_delay_help: Wait a random integer number of seconds within the configured interval before each guild raid attack, then recheck the area.
long_rest_duration_help: Rest duration after the cumulative threshold; zero disables this rest. Does not reset the daily total.
sleep_start_help: Sleep window start, including overnight windows. Running tasks pause input at supported safe checkpoints. The game and device stay open.
antiban_enable_help: Enable sleep windows, cumulative long rests and a separate daily runtime limit. Running tasks pause at supported safe checkpoints. Click timing has its own switch. These controls do not guarantee avoiding detection.
daily_active_limit_help: Legacy cumulative-run-then-rest threshold, not a daily limit. Zero disables it. Runtime and rest deadlines persist across restarts.
click_timing_enable_help: Independent of the rest switch. Wait 0.06-0.18s before ordinary clicks; minitouch holds for 40-110ms. Other backends keep their press behavior. Does not guarantee avoiding detection.
daily_runtime_limit_help: Zero disables the limit. Persist execution time by configuration and local date, including failed tasks. Rests do not count or reset the daily total. Pause at supported safe checkpoints until the next day, also respecting the sleep window. Forced termination may lose the last unflushed interval.
itachi_coin_buy_jade_help: Buy the auto-forwarded Itachi gift boxes. Each box is opened only once; if the purchase dialog does not appear within three seconds, the weekly shop is treated as already purchased.
save_ocr_log_help: Disabled by default. When enabled, saves OCR input images and recognized text for debugging.
quick_loadout_enable_help: Equip preset souls and deploy the preset from the in-battle quick loadout panel; skips the legacy soul switch and battle preset, then applies the team-lock state from general battle settings
quick_loadout_mode_help: mode_number selects by group and preset number; mode_ocr selects by group and preset name
quick_loadout_group_number_help: Preset group number in the quick loadout panel
quick_loadout_preset_number_help: Preset number in the selected group
quick_loadout_group_name_help: Preset group name used in OCR mode
quick_loadout_preset_name_help: Preset name used in OCR mode
quick_loadout_custom_preset_enable_help: Select quick-loadout presets by stage name; deploy the preset and equip its souls once for each new boss challenge
quick_loadout_custom_preset_help: Format: boss_name:("group number or name","preset number or name"); separate entries with semicolons; ALL matches every monster not explicitly configured; OCR mode treats both values as names
execution_mode_help: Timed by default. Manual runs once per frontend Run now request, ignoring schedules, entry times and rest waits; count/runtime limits and stuck detection remain. Idle tasks yield to normal tasks and require a reward checkpoint and safe exit adapter.
idle_goal_help: Accumulate daily, weekly or per configuration session. Either enabled count or runtime limit completes the goal. Daily reset: local midnight; weekly reset: Monday midnight.
idle_start_minutes_help: Start or resume when no normal task is due and the next is more than Y minutes away. Y must exceed X.
idle_stop_minutes_help: After rewards, yield to the courtyard when the next normal task is at most X minutes away. Never interrupts combat or predicts round duration.
